filesystem.description: Read/write/list/search files within the project root.

terminal.description: Run shell commands (PowerShell-first on Windows, bash elsewhere).

git.description: git status/diff/log/commit against the current repo.

knowledge.description: Search/grow the hierarchical project knowledge base (rules, descriptions, code templates), scoped by module.

memory.description: Collect, retrieve, and preserve source-backed reusable Coder Knowledge Memory artefacts.

sandbox.description: Create isolated source copies and run allow-listed verification profiles without writing to the working tree.

browser.description: Run local Playwright user journeys: click, fill, assert visible/text/URL, and capture screenshots.

web.description: Web search (DuckDuckGo) and URL fetch for research and fact-checking.

ml.description: ML/AI engineering: model recommendation, training script generation, export format suggestions, inference cost estimation.

desktop_testing.description: Desktop GUI automation, screen capture, computer vision, OCR, pixel/color verification.

document_testing.description: PowerPoint and Word file inspection, design consistency, structure validation, color palette analysis.
